text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-4921 fired — 502 error spike observed on kv-proxy (us-west1). 5m avg 4.8% (threshold 1%). Auto-ack window 30s. Links: https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/PD-4921 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Page sent to @alice-oncall, ring to SRE rotation 1
alice-oncall: Acked. I'm on-call now. Looking at prod dashboards.
ben-sre: I see the 502 spike, tailing proxy logs now.
alice-oncall: Running logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=kv-proxy --since=10m | tail -n 200`
ben-sre: Errors look like upstream `connect: connection reset by peer` from backend pool azb-2. Also a lot of `kv cache eviction` spikes.
carla-runtime: @alice-oncall can we drain azb-2 from the load balancer? If we isolate the pool we can restore p99 quickly.
alice-oncall: Issuing route change to orchestrator: 
alice-oncall: ```bash
POST /v1/routes/reweight
{"slice":"azb-2","weight":0.0}
``` (curl done)
incident-bot: Route change accepted, reweight job id rj-20260317-12
darren-support: Noting customer reports: three customers reported transient 502s, volume small but visible in support queue. Raising on status page.
alice-oncall: Error rate dropping to 0.9% (2m). Continuing to monitor. Will keep this thread updated.
ben-sre: Agree error rate trending down. Suggest keeping azb-2 drained and kicking pool for a full recycle.
carla-runtime: Will do rolling restart of kv-proxy on azb-2, image 1.14 -> 1.14.1 with connection pool fix. Starting rollout to 4 nodes.
alice-oncall: Escalating to eng-runtime for root cause: @carla-runtime please take ownership post-mitigation.
eve-product: Notifying customers via private SLA channel, pinging key accounts.
alice-oncall: Handing off monitoring to ben-sre for next 30m. I'll be offline for scheduled meeting at 02:00 UTC. Ben, please take oncall notes in PD.
ben-sre: Acked handoff. I'll watch dashboards and confirm full recovery.
alice-oncall: last check p50 120ms, p95 240ms, 502 rate 0.3%. Closing pager for now but leaving thread open for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
carla-runtime: Rolling restart completed on azb-2 nodes, post-check shows no connect resets. Root cause likely socket exhaustion in 1.14; will open PR and schedule postmortem if needed.
darren-support: Status page updated: "Service degraded briefly, mitigation applied — no major customer impact."
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4921 auto-resolved.
ben-sre: I'll add notes to the incident doc and link logs: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/PD-4921
alice-oncall: Thanks all. If anything spikes again, re-open pager and tag SRE rotation. /end
